description_en: Adds or removes authorized users for a specified application deployed in a delivery group. Only authorized users can access the application
description_zh: 为交付组中已部署的指定应用添加或移除授权用户。只有被授权的用户才能访问该应用
name: AuthorizeUsersForApp

parameters.help_en:
The delivery group ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/428506.html operation to obtain the ID.

The application specified by AppId must be deployed in the image used by this delivery group
parameters.help_zh:
交付组 ID。可调用 https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/428506.html 接口获取。

该交付组使用的镜像中必须已部署 AppId 指定的应用
parameters.name: app_instance_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The product type. Application-level authorization applies to WUYING Cloud Application delivery groups.

Valid values:

CloudApp: WUYING Cloud Application
parameters.help_zh:
产品类型。按应用授权适用于无影云应用交付组。

取值：

CloudApp：无影云应用
parameters.name: product_type

parameters.help_en:
The list of usernames to add authorization for the application. A maximum of 100 usernames can be specified in a single request.

At least one of AuthorizeUserIds and UnAuthorizeUserIds must be specified. You can also specify both. Adding authorization is subject to the authorized user quota for the application
parameters.help_zh:
要为该应用添加授权的用户名列表。单次最多传入 100 个。

与 UnAuthorizeUserIds 至少指定一个，也可以同时指定。新增授权受该应用的授权用户配额限制
parameters.name: authorize_user_ids

parameters.help_en:
The list of usernames to be unauthorized for the application. A maximum of 100 usernames can be specified in a single request.

At least one of AuthorizeUserIds and UnAuthorizeUserIds must be specified. You can also specify both. Removing authorizations is not subject to quota limits
parameters.help_zh:
要为该应用移除授权的用户名列表。单次最多传入 100 个。

与 AuthorizeUserIds 至少指定一个，也可以同时指定。移除授权不受配额限制
parameters.name: un_authorize_user_ids

fields.help_en: The AD domain name. Specify this parameter when Type is set to ad. The value must match the AD domain bound to the workspace of the delivery group
fields.help_zh: AD 域名。Type 取值为 ad 时填写，且必须与交付组所属工作区绑定的 AD 域一致
fields.name: ad_domain

fields.help_en:
The account type. Default value: simple.

Valid values:

ad: AD account.
simple: WUYING convenience account
fields.help_zh:
账号类型。默认值：simple。

取值：

ad：AD 账号。
simple：无影便捷账号
fields.name: type

parameters.help_en:
The account information of the authorized user, which specifies the account type corresponding to the username.

If the workspace to which the delivery group belongs is an AD workspace, this parameter is required: set Type to ad and set AdDomain to the AD domain bound to the workspace.
If this parameter is not specified, the WUYING convenience account (simple) is used by default
parameters.help_zh:
授权用户的账号信息，用于指定用户名对应的账号类型。

交付组所属工作区为 AD 工作区时必须传入：Type 取值为 ad，AdDomain 与工作区绑定的 AD 域一致。
不传入时，默认按无影便捷账号（simple）处理
parameters.name: user_meta

parameters.help_en: The application ID. The application must be deployed in the image used by the delivery group. You can obtain the ID from the Apps list returned by the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/600836.html operation
parameters.help_zh: 应用 ID。必须是该交付组使用的镜像中已部署的应用，可通过 https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/600836.html 接口返回的 Apps 列表获取
parameters.name: app_id
